general.label: General
general.headline: Software Engineer — Backend & Systems Architecture
general.retrievalQuery: software engineer backend systems distributed architecture fullstack web NestJS Rust PostgreSQL Redis APIs system design concurrency WebSockets React TypeScript Docker Linux CI/CD OpenTelemetry observability Jira production on-premise LangGraph RAG

technicalScopes.label: Backend Systems & Architecture
technicalScopes.guidance: High-performance backend services in Rust (Axum) and NestJS, REST and WebSocket APIs, concurrency, PostgreSQL schema design, TimescaleDB, and Redis caching.

technicalScopes.label: Fullstack Web Development
technicalScopes.guidance: End-to-end web engineering in React and TypeScript, responsive PWAs, mobile Capacitor bridges, real-time client state synchronization, and seamless API integration.

technicalScopes.label: Cloud, DevOps & Observability
technicalScopes.guidance: Linux system administration, Docker multi-arch containers (AMD64/ARM64), CI/CD automation, Jira agile project tracking, and OpenTelemetry/Prometheus observability.

technicalScopes.label: Applied AI, RAG & Intelligent Systems
technicalScopes.guidance: Evidence-grounded RAG pipelines, LangGraph structured extraction, vector databases (pgvector), and contextual automation integrated into production software.

writingPolicy.identity: Present Faris clearly as a Software Engineer specialized in Backend Systems & Fullstack Web Development, with solid production engineering experience across robust backend architectures, distributed services, databases, and modern web applications. Machine learning is not his identity; applied AI/RAG is treated strictly as an integrated software capability.
writingPolicy.focus: Emphasize high-performance backend systems (Rust, NestJS), database design and query optimization (PostgreSQL, Redis), real-time protocols (WebSockets, MQTT), production observability (OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana), agile delivery (Jira), and end-to-end fullstack web engineering (React, TypeScript), backed by containerized production deployments and applied AI/RAG workflows.
avoid: Machine Learning Engineer or Data Scientist positioning
selecting or including DBS Foundation or any Machine Learning Engineer roles in the CV; focus exclusively on backend, fullstack, and cloud software engineering roles
generic filler such as passionate, hardworking, cutting-edge, innovative
appearing only as a superficial or hobbyist developer without production ownership
AI-only identity that obscures strong core backend and software craft
